endorsements.name: Zhang Yaoliang
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-0751
endorsements.description: A vulnerability classified as critical has been found in Axiomatic Bento4 up to 1.6.0. This affects the function AP4_BitReader::ReadBits of the component mp42aac. The manipulation leads to heap-based buffer overflow. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: UNKNOWN (CVSS 2.0, 7.5)
